seoTitle: Meme Generator: Add Top and Bottom Text to an Image
metaDescription: Put classic white outlined meme text at the top and bottom of any image, auto-sized to fit, and save as PNG. The picture stays on your device.
intro: Caption an image the classic way without uploading it to a meme site.
why:
Choose an image, type top and bottom text (uppercase optional) and download the result. The text uses an Impact-style font with a black outline, wraps to at most three lines and shrinks to fit the width. Large images are scaled down to your chosen maximum width.

The tool adds text only. Respect copyright and people's privacy when you caption photos.

The file is read in your browser and is not uploaded anywhere.
howTo: Type the top and bottom text.

faq.a: No, it is drawn in your browser.
Impact if installed, otherwise a bold condensed sans-serif.
